However, it failed because the `vec_binop` function did not properly handle the dimensions of the arrays being operated on. Specifically, it seems that the `libops.vec_binop` call was expecting a one-dimensional array but received a two-dimensional one, leading to a `ValueError`.

The issue likely arises from the way `na_logical_op` falls back to using `vec_binop` when a `TypeError` is raised. Since `na_logical_op` does not correctly handle the dimensionality of the arrays in all cases, it leads to this error.
